source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Involve the employees affected.
3. Fill out an incident report form.
4. Include a detailed description of the incident.
5. Document the date and time of the incident.
6. Note the location of the incident.
7. Describe any injuries or illnesses resulting from the incident.
8. Record the names and positions of witnesses.
9. Record the company's name and department.
10. Attach any visual evidence like photos or videos.
11. Write down any immediate corrective actions taken.
12. Include any workplace safety inspections or violations identified.
13. Record subsequent counseling or training sessions conducted.
14. Keep records of follow-up medical treatment and rehabilitation.
15. Document any lost time or restricted work activities due to the incident.
16. Review and validate the report for accuracy.
17. Store the report securely in a confidential location.
18. Ensure compliance with local and national regulatory reporting requirements.

Remember, it's essential that reports are completed as soon as possible
